segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let width: CGFloat = 640 let height: CGFloat = 640 let shapeLayer = CAShapeLayer() shapeLayer.frame = CGRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: height) let path = CGMutablePath() stride(from: 0, to: CGFloat.pi * 2, by: CGFloat.pi / 6).forEach { angle in var transform = CGAffineTransform(rotationAngle: angle) .concatenating(CGAffineTransform(translationX: width / 2, y: height / 2)) let petal = CGPath(ellipseIn: CGRect(x: -20, y: 0, width: 40, height: 100), transform: &transform) path.addPath(petal) } shapeLayer.path = path shapeLayer.strokeColor = UIColor.red.cgColor shapeLayer.fillColor = UIColor.yellow.cgColor shapeLayer.fillRule = kCAFillRuleEvenOdd ```
